title: Sentinel-2 L2A STAC-GeoParquet Mirror
description: An item index for the AWS Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A archive (about 28 million scenes, 2015 to today), published as partitioned STAC-GeoParquet plus MGRS-tile aggregate stats. The imagery stays on AWS in the sentinel-cogs bucket; this catalog carries no assets, so a client derives each Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF URL from the item's MGRS tile and date. No STAC API sits in front of it: query the Parquet files directly. This is a mirror; Earth Search / Element 84 produces the item index this catalog republishes. Read the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) before you query it.
